Updated the existing Treasury Bulletin leading-digit counting skill and compacted the durable memory note.

Key generalizable lesson saved:
For “tables on pdf page …” prompts, especially dense 1980-era Treasury Bulletin pages, do a visual inventory of every separate table/continuation panel on the page. A count short by ~20–30 leading digits likely means an entire lower/adjacent table block was omitted, not just OCR noise.
